title: What Is Emface®?
paragraphs: Aging is a natural process, but we all want to defy it no matter what. Everybody undergoes this phase of life in their own time. Whether you like it or not, you are not the same as you were ten years ago. Wrinkles, grey hair, sagging skin, and other things come to mind, but it is beyond that. Everybody wants to maintain their youthfulness as they grow older. Botox and fillers are some of the most popular anti-aging treatments. They appear to have shown promising results in skin rejuvenation. Facial injectables are invasive and temporary solutions but are highly in demand in the market. BTL has come up with a new procedure called Emface® for skin rejuvenation. It is a one-of-a-kind device that will likely change the aging of the face.

Recently, the introduced Emface® device combines radiofrequency with electromagnetic stimulation to lift and tighten. They work together to create a treatment to lift and sculpt the face without injections. Emface® works similarly to Emsculpt, where High-Intensity Facial Electrical Stimulation (HIFES) contracts and strengthens delicate facial muscles, causing a lifting effect.

Emface® is the first device that utilizes synchronized radio frequency (RF) and High-Intensity Facial Electrical Stimulation (HIFES). The radiofrequency heats collagen and elastin fibers while the HIFES emits thousands of pulses per session to contract facial muscles. You may lie down and relax as it may feel like a facial massage with a warming sensation in the treated area. The non-invasive procedure addresses the forehead, eyebrows, cheeks, and jawline without downtime. You may have to undergo four sessions of 20 minutes each over four to six weeks for visible results. While anybody can benefit from this procedure, do not apply it over hair or scar tissue or if you have electronic or metal implants.
